candidate.answerReason: Equidistance gives 3x−2=x+6, hence 2x=8 and x=4. Both perpendicular lengths then equal 10, so the result is geometrically admissible.

methods.label: Equate the perpendicular lengths
methods.explanation: A point on an angle bisector is equidistant from the two sides, so \(3x-2=x+6\). Solving gives \(x=4\).
